agents_defaults_timezone_mode.label: System timezone
agents_defaults_timezone_mode.help: Turn off to choose a timezone manually.

agents_defaults_timezone.label: Timezone
agents_defaults_timezone.help: Choose a timezone. UTC offsets reflect the current date.

agents_defaults_max_tool_iterations.label: Execution rounds per segment
agents_defaults_max_tool_iterations.help: Maximum model and tool rounds in one execution segment; separate from Goal continuation limits.

agents_defaults_max_concurrent_subagents.label: Concurrent subagents
agents_defaults_max_concurrent_subagents.help: Maximum number of subagents running at the same time.

agents_defaults_max_tool_result_chars.label: Tool result limit (characters)
agents_defaults_max_tool_result_chars.help: Maximum characters from each tool result sent to the model.

agents_defaults_provider_retry_mode.label: Keep retrying
agents_defaults_provider_retry_mode.help: Keep retrying requests after recoverable errors. Turn off to use standard retries.

agents_defaults_tool_status_summary_max_.label: Tool status summary limit (characters)
agents_defaults_tool_status_summary_max_.help: Maximum characters shown in channel tool activity summaries.

tools_max_outgoing_session_messages_per_.label: Outgoing cross-conversation messages (per minute)
tools_max_outgoing_session_messages_per_.help: Each source conversation can send this many messages to other conversations in a rolling 60-second window. This does not limit your messages.

tools_exec_enable.label: Shell tool
tools_exec_enable.help: Allow the agent to run shell commands.

tools_file_enable.label: File tools
tools_file_enable.help: Allow built-in file reading and editing tools.

tools_web_enable.label: Web access
tools_web_enable.help: Allow web search and web fetch tools.

tools_cli_apps_enable.label: CLI apps
tools_cli_apps_enable.help: Allow the agent to manage and run CLI apps.

tools_my_enable.label: Inspect agent runtime
tools_my_enable.help: Allow runtime inspection through runtime tools; service secrets are excluded.

tools_my_allow_set.label: Change agent runtime
tools_my_allow_set.help: Allow runtime tools to change supported agent settings.

tools_exec_path_prepend.label: PATH priority
tools_exec_path_prepend.help: Directories added to the start of PATH. Separate entries with semicolons on Windows or colons on Linux and macOS.

tools_exec_path_append.label: PATH additions
tools_exec_path_append.help: Directories added to the end of PATH. Separate entries with semicolons on Windows or colons on Linux and macOS.

tools_exec_sandbox.label: Command sandbox
tools_exec_sandbox.help: Use bwrap on Linux or Seatbelt on macOS. Workspace checks alone do not isolate processes.

tools_exec_sandbox_ro_binds.label: Read-only paths
tools_exec_sandbox_ro_binds.help: Additional paths mounted read-only. One path per line.

tools_exec_sandbox_rw_binds.label: Writable paths
tools_exec_sandbox_rw_binds.help: Additional paths mounted with write access. One path per line.

tools_exec_allowed_env_keys.label: Environment variables
tools_exec_allowed_env_keys.help: Additional environment variables to pass from the host to commands, alongside required variables. One name per line.

tools_exec_allow_patterns.label: Allowed commands
tools_exec_allow_patterns.help: One regular expression per line. When set, every command segment must fully match an allow rule. Matches override built-in and custom deny rules; workspace and network restrictions still apply.

tools_exec_deny_patterns.label: Blocked commands
tools_exec_deny_patterns.help: One regular expression per line, checked alongside built-in deny rules. Commands that fully match allow rules skip these checks.

network_proxy.label: Shared proxy
network_proxy.help: Address used by features with Use proxy enabled. 127.0.0.1 is the machine running cirno.

tools_web_use_proxy.label: Use proxy
tools_web_use_proxy.help: Use the shared proxy for web search and page reading.

tools_web_user_agent.label: User agent
tools_web_user_agent.help: User-Agent header sent with web requests. Leave blank to use the default.

tools_restrict_to_workspace.label: Workspace restriction
tools_restrict_to_workspace.help: Limits files and shell commands to the working directory when a conversation uses the tool policy. Explicit conversation permissions take precedence.

tools_ssrf_whitelist.label: Allowed IPs
tools_ssrf_whitelist.help: Allow outbound requests to these otherwise restricted addresses. Enter one IP address or CIDR range per line.

tools_cli_apps_install_timeout.label: Install timeout
tools_cli_apps_install_timeout.help: Time allowed for CLI app installation.

tools_cli_apps_run_timeout.label: Run timeout
tools_cli_apps_run_timeout.help: Time allowed for a CLI app command.

tools_cli_apps_catalog_ttl_seconds.label: Cache duration
tools_cli_apps_catalog_ttl_seconds.help: How long the CLI app catalog stays cached.

agents_defaults_idle_compact_check_inter.label: Idle consolidation check interval (seconds)
agents_defaults_idle_compact_check_inter.help: How often to check conversations for idle consolidation; separate from the inactivity timeout. Restart to apply.

network_request_timeout_s.label: Model connection / response timeout (seconds)
network_request_timeout_s.help: Time allowed to connect or wait for a non-streaming response. Active streams use the separate idle timeout.

network_stream_idle_timeout_s.label: Model stream idle timeout (seconds)
network_stream_idle_timeout_s.help: Maximum time without new stream data before a model request times out.

agents_defaults_idle_compact_percent.label: Idle consolidation trigger (%)
agents_defaults_idle_compact_percent.help: Percentage of the current model’s context window. 0 disables idle consolidation; model configurations can override.

agents_defaults_idle_compact_keep_percen.label: Recent context retention (%)
agents_defaults_idle_compact_keep_percen.help: Retain complete recent turns, measured against the model window. Must be below the trigger.

agents_defaults_goal_continuation_limit.label: Default Goal continuation limit
agents_defaults_goal_continuation_limit.help: 0 means unlimited. Counts persist; individual Goals can override.

agents_defaults_memory_context_tokens.label: Shared memory budget (tokens)
agents_defaults_memory_context_tokens.help: Maximum MEMORY.md injection. Full memory stays in Home.

agents_defaults_memory_checkpoint_tokens.label: Task checkpoint budget (tokens)
agents_defaults_memory_checkpoint_tokens.help: Restore this much task state as part of context consolidation.

agents_defaults_memory_index_scan_batch.label: Index scan batch
agents_defaults_memory_index_scan_batch.help: Files checked per idle maintenance pass.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_enabled.label: Semantic retrieval
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_enabled.help: Optional vectors alongside BM25. Choose local CPU inference or an external API. API mode sends queries and memory chunks to the configured service; disabled by default.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_model_p.label: ONNX model path
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_model_p.help: Local BGE-small INT8 ONNX model; no automatic download.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_tokeniz.label: Tokenizer path
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_tokeniz.help: Matching tokenizer.json for the selected BGE model.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_max_rss.label: Embedding worker limit (MB)
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_max_rss.help: Peak embedding worker memory budget (MiB), including model loading. Accepts 512, 1024 or higher. Exceeding it falls back to BM25; this is not a whole-service limit.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_timeout.label: Embedding timeout (seconds)
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_timeout.help: Time budget for the whole embedding search, including the query and all incremental indexing batches. A visible timeout falls back to BM25.

agents_defaults_memory_release_archived_.label: Free memory after consolidation
agents_defaults_memory_release_archived_.help: After consolidation, retain the complete evidence on disk and display history while releasing old execution messages from RAM.

tools_exec_max_runtime.label: Command runtime
tools_exec_max_runtime.help: Output and waiting do not extend it. Choose No time limit to remove this limit.

server_health_host.label: Health endpoint bind address
server_health_host.help: Address for the service health endpoint; Web UI listens on its own address in Channel setup.

server_health_port.label: Health endpoint port
server_health_port.help: Service health port, separate from the Web UI port. Restart to apply.

server_restart_mode.label: Restart mode
server_restart_mode.help: Choose how the Cirno server restarts. Automatic selects a method for your environment.

agents_defaults_resume_message.label: Continuation message
agents_defaults_resume_message.help: Instruction sent when you press Continue or use /resume.

agents_defaults_resume_show_message.label: Show continuation message
agents_defaults_resume_show_message.help: Display the continuation instruction as a labeled system input in the conversation.

agents_defaults_workspace.label: Default workspace
agents_defaults_workspace.help: Absolute directory on the server. Restart to apply. Existing files and conversations keep their original locations.

agents_defaults_approval_enabled.label: Enable AI review
agents_defaults_approval_enabled.help: When disabled, operations requiring approval go directly to you.

agents_defaults_approval_model_override.label: Review model
agents_defaults_approval_model_override.help: Leave empty to use the conversation model with a fresh review context.

agents_defaults_approval_timeout_seconds.label: Review timeout (seconds)
agents_defaults_approval_timeout_seconds.help: A timeout sends the operation to you for approval.

agents_defaults_active_compact_percent.label: Active consolidation trigger (%)
agents_defaults_active_compact_percent.help: Percentage of the selected model’s context window. Checked before each model request, including tool rounds. Output space and a safety reserve are always protected; 100 uses the maximum safe input budget. This does not change idle consolidation.

channels_send_progress.label: Progress messages
channels_send_progress.help: Send intermediate assistant text to connected channels. Web UI execution details remain available.

channels_send_tool_hints.label: Tool status messages
channels_send_tool_hints.help: Send short tool activity updates to connected channels.

channels_show_reasoning.label: Reasoning messages
channels_show_reasoning.help: Send reasoning updates when the channel supports them. Web UI detail expansion is controlled separately.

channels_show_compaction_notices.label: Automatic consolidation notices
channels_show_compaction_notices.help: Send automatic context consolidation notices to connected channels. Web UI consolidation events remain visible.

channels_send_max_retries.label: Delivery attempts
channels_send_max_retries.help: Maximum delivery attempts, including the first. 0 disables retries, not delivery.

tools_exec_idle_timeout.label: Command silence timeout (seconds)
tools_exec_idle_timeout.help: Time without command output before applying the action below. 0 disables silence detection. This is not the conversation idle timer.

tools_exec_idle_action.label: After command silence
tools_exec_idle_action.help: Report keeps the command running; terminate stops it. Quiet research jobs should normally use Report.

tools_exec_max_runtime_limit.label: Maximum requested command duration (seconds)
tools_exec_max_runtime_limit.help: Largest duration the model may request for one command. 0 removes this ceiling. The default command duration remains separate.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_bas.label: API base URL
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_bas.help: OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as https://host/v1, or a full /embeddings endpoint. Self-hosted HTTP endpoints are supported.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_key.label: API key
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_key.help: Stored privately in the instance configuration. Existing keys are masked; leave empty for a service without authentication.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_mod.label: Embedding model
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_mod.help: The model identifier accepted by your embedding service. Changing the endpoint, model or chunk size uses a separate index.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_chu.label: Chunk size (characters)
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_api_chu.help: Overlapping character chunks for the external API. Lower this if the service has a small input limit. Up to 32 chunks are indexed per search.

agents_defaults_memory_embedding_provide.label: Embedding service
agents_defaults_memory_embedding_provide.help: Optional vectors alongside BM25. Choose local CPU inference or an external API. API mode sends queries and memory chunks to the configured service; disabled by default.

server_uploads_max_file_mb.label: File size limit (MiB)
server_uploads_max_file_mb.help: Maximum uploaded size per image or document. Restart and refresh the browser to apply.

server_uploads_max_video_mb.label: Video size limit (MiB)
server_uploads_max_video_mb.help: Maximum size per uploaded video; one video per message. Restart and refresh the browser to apply.

server_uploads_max_total_mb.label: Files per message (MiB)
server_uploads_max_total_mb.help: Combined uploaded image and document size per message, excluding video. Local file references are excluded. Restart and refresh the browser to apply.

agents_defaults_system_prompts_shared.label: Shared additional system prompt
agents_defaults_system_prompts_shared.help: Applied to Router and Workers before their role-specific additions. Automatically saved; applies from the next turn. Leave empty to disable.

agents_defaults_system_prompts_router.label: Router additional system prompt
agents_defaults_system_prompts_router.help: Applied only to Router after the shared addition. Automatically saved; applies from the next turn. Framework delegation and tool limits still apply.

agents_defaults_system_prompts_worker.label: Worker additional system prompt
agents_defaults_system_prompts_worker.help: Applied only to Workers after the shared addition. Automatically saved; applies from the next turn. Leave empty to use only the shared addition.

agents_defaults_consolidation_max_tokens.label: Consolidation output budget (tokens)
agents_defaults_consolidation_max_tokens.help: Task checkpoint and memory updates share this output budget, capped by the model output limit.

agents_defaults_consolidation_reasoning_.label: Checkpoint reasoning effort
agents_defaults_consolidation_reasoning_.help: Use lower effort to leave room for the checkpoint text. Inherit uses the conversation model’s effort; unsupported values follow the provider’s mapping.

agents_defaults_consolidation_checkpoint.label: Checkpoint reminder (%)
agents_defaults_consolidation_checkpoint.help: Remind the agent to save task state before this percentage of the active input budget. This does not interrupt a running model request.

agents_defaults_consolidation_output_res.label: Minimum output space (%)
agents_defaults_consolidation_output_res.help: Reserve this share of the context window for the next response, capped by its configured output limit. Default 5%. The actual output limit shrinks with the remaining space; the maximum output setting does not reserve its full value.

agents_defaults_consolidation_learn.label: Learn during consolidation
agents_defaults_consolidation_learn.help: Produce task checkpoints, durable memories and verified Skill improvements in the same request, without a separate model run.

agents_defaults_consolidation_max_update.label: Maximum updates per consolidation
agents_defaults_consolidation_max_update.help: Bound the total memory and document updates. A pass may produce no useful updates.

agents_defaults_consolidation_context_ch.label: Additional reference budget (characters)
agents_defaults_consolidation_context_ch.help: Bound existing memories and complete document snapshots appended at the request tail, preserving the system prefix.
